completeDraftSets.camera: Fixed side three-quarter facing left, full GHD and athlete visible.
completeDraftSets.equipment: Rigid GHD with rounded thigh pads, ankle rollers and footplate; no added weight.
reviewFindings: Repaired the white middle-frame background to black. Selected base and footplate regions are copied exactly from the setup, removing fixed-equipment redraw within those regions.
Body proportions, changing knee-pad contact and full-range mechanics still require review. This remains a partial-range draft; fixed machine pixels do not establish anatomical approval.

frames.caption: SET UPRIGHT 1/6
frames.cue: Secure feet; brace with arms across chest.

frames.caption: BEGIN LOWERING 2/6
frames.cue: Lower slowly by extending at your knees.

frames.caption: CONTROL YOUR RANGE 3/6
frames.cue: Keep knees, hips and head aligned.

frames.caption: STAY BRACED 4/6
frames.cue: Keep hips extended and hamstrings under tension.

frames.caption: CURL UPWARD 5/6
frames.cue: Use hamstrings and glutes to rise smoothly.

frames.caption: RETURN UPRIGHT 6/6
frames.cue: Finish tall without arching your lower back.

completeDraftSets.camera: Fixed side three-quarter facing left; heel clearance and lower-back pad visible.
completeDraftSets.equipment: Real donkey calf machine with forefoot step, fixed forward hand supports, vertical moving lower-back loading pad on a guided carriage.
reviewFindings: Replaced the flat setup with a shorter step and overhanging lowered heels. New neutral and raised positions give distinct heel progression on a consistent black background.

Fixed machine base, handle support and lower upright regions now reuse setup pixels. The generated step rear edge still changes and foot/pad mechanics and body proportions remain unapproved; this repair does not grant release approval.

frames.caption: SET YOUR STRETCH 1/6
frames.cue: Brace forward; let heels lower below platform.

frames.caption: RISE THROUGH YOUR TOES 2/6
frames.cue: Lift heels while keeping knees softly straight.

frames.caption: REACH THE TOP 3/6
frames.cue: Rise onto toes and squeeze your calves.

frames.caption: CONTROL THE TOP 4/6
frames.cue: Pause briefly without bouncing or bending knees.

frames.caption: LOWER SLOWLY 5/6
frames.cue: Lower heels slowly against the resistance.

frames.caption: RETURN TO STRETCH 6/6
frames.cue: Let heels sink below the platform gently.

completeDraftSets.camera: Fixed side three-quarter facing right, both shoes and working-foot heel visible.
completeDraftSets.equipment: Bodyweight on level floor, no bench or assistance.
reviewFindings: Repaired black background and fixed the planted working sole and lower shoe by rigidly translating each lowering pose and reusing the master contact region. A 70-row contour-aligned calf bridge prevents a doubled edge.
The shoe region is exact, but the calf bridge is locally resampled and must be reviewed for anatomy and sharpness. Whole-body proportions and balance remain unapproved.

frames.caption: BALANCE ON ONE LEG 1/6
frames.cue: Stand on one leg; extend the other.

frames.caption: SIT BACK AND DOWN 2/6
frames.cue: Bend your standing knee; keep heel planted.

frames.caption: REACH CONTROLLED DEPTH 3/6
frames.cue: Lower near your heel without losing balance.

frames.caption: KEEP YOUR POSITION 4/6
frames.cue: Keep free leg lifted and knee aligned.

frames.caption: DRIVE UPWARD 5/6
frames.cue: Push through your planted foot to stand.

frames.caption: FINISH BEFORE SWITCHING 6/6
frames.cue: Stand tall, then repeat the other side.
